faqs.question: Is there a free trial available?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer a 14-day free trial of our Pro plan with no credit card required. You can explore all features and decide if TaskFlow Pro is right for your team.

faqs.question: Can I import data from other project management tools?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We support one-click imports from Asana, Trello, Monday.com, Jira, and more. Our migration wizard makes switching painless.

faqs.question: What happens when my trial ends?
faqs.answer: You can choose to upgrade to a paid plan or continue with our free Starter plan. Your data will always be preserved, and you can upgrade at any time.

faqs.question: Is my data secure?
faqs.answer: Security is our top priority. We use bank-level 256-bit encryption, are SOC 2 Type II certified, GDPR compliant, and offer SSO for enterprise customers.

faqs.question: Do you offer discounts for nonprofits or education?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer 50% off for verified nonprofits and free Pro accounts for educational institutions. Contact our sales team to learn more.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time with no penalties. If you cancel, you'll continue to have access until the end of your billing period.
